current_activity: Capture of Stuttgart: a French column breaks into the city from the northeast
notes: Event date: 21 April 1945 (inferred value: CMH The Last Offensive, p. 429, gives the date of the French column; Wikipedia gives April 1945 for the division). Event definition: The division takes part in the assault and capture of Stuttgart; a French column envelops the city by Esslingen and breaks into its northeastern fringe on 21 April, and the city is clear on 22 April. Event support: two source families (Wikipedia and the US Army official history (CMH)). Wikipedia, 5th Armored Division (France), section World War II: "The 5th Armored Division particularly distinguished itself in the assault and capture of Stuttgart, Germany in April 1945"; CMH The Last Offensive ch. 18 p. 429: "a French column the next day pushed down the valley of the Neckar by way of Esslingen, enveloped Stuttgart, and broke into the northeastern fringe of the city early in the afternoon". Location: Stuttgart, Baden-Württemberg with a precision of 10 km. Location support: Wikipedia names Stuttgart for the division; the date is an inferred value: the CMH history dates the French column without naming the division, so confidence 0.3.
